confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on several 2026 Melbourne sources (guides, listings, one aggregator), not an official price survey or cost-of-living index. Cocktail and wine are less certain than coffee and restaurant anchors, and some beer and drink figures come from happy-hour listings or top-venue ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Melbourne; no booking pages or current listings were checked. The FX observation is the latest RBA rate I could verify (20 March 2026), not the latest rate on the generation date, so it should be refreshed from the RBA before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city basis was used. Food and drink anchors are Melbourne-specific from search sources. Accommodation anchors are a Melbourne-specific holistic model estimate.
